name: claude-code-mods
description: Mods for Claude Code: plugins that change how Claude Code itself behaves.

plugins.name: dictation-cleanup
plugins.description: Cleans dictated or typed prompts before they are sent: filler sounds, words that say nothing, typos, spoken quotation marks, project names spelled as the project's docs spell them, and a Haiku pass whose changes are checked word by word.

plugins.name: tool-output-diet
plugins.description: Trims shell output before Claude reads it: colour codes, overwritten progress-bar frames and long runs of identical lines. Nothing else is touched.

plugins.name: no-ai-trailers
plugins.description: Keeps the Claude co-author trailer and the Generated-with footer out of your commits and pull requests.

plugins.name: studio-state
plugins.description: Gives Claude a studio_state tool for a studio-layout video repository: one compact answer on where a video project stands. Silent in every other folder.

plugins.name: deferred-answers
plugins.description: Keeps 'later', 'not yet' and 'after X' answers to Claude's questions open: the question and your answer ride along with every message until the item is done or dropped.

plugins.name: reply-diet
plugins.description: Shortens the quotes in stacked replies before they are sent: a long quoted passage that is already in the conversation is cut to its first and last words. Your own words are never touched. Also lets you edit attached replies before they are sent.
